body: Speech recognition on low-cost microcontrollers is, in practice, limited to keyword spotting or a fixed list of commands. We present Oído, an inference engine that runs open-vocabulary English speech recognition entirely on an ESP32-S3 (240 MHz dual-core Xtensa LX7, 512 KB of SRAM, 8 MB of PSRAM, 16 MB of flash, no neural accelerator). Oído executes a 13M-parameter Conformer-CTC model with int8 weights, per-frame dynamic int8 activations and int8 attention on the chip's SIMD instructions, with a schedule designed around flash and PSRAM bandwidth. On LibriSpeech test-clean/test-other the on-device arithmetic reaches 3.70%/8.23% word error rate (WER), within 0.12 points of full precision, and 3.33%/7.15% with an on-chip 1.3M-parameter language model; a transducer head gives 2.99%/6.67% and an int4 variant fits in 8.3 MB. This is 2.3-2.8x fewer errors than the vendor's recognizer on the same chip, and fewer than Whisper tiny.en and Moonshine tiny in full precision on a laptop, including in real noise and reverberation. Measured on a physical board, the firmware runs at 1.97x the duration of the audio on one core, with transcripts identical to an instruction-exact emulator: accurate, but not yet real time (a 4 s command is transcribed about 8.7 s after it ends). The two-core schedule gives wrong results on silicon and is disabled. A streaming variant shows partial text while the speaker talks and delivers the final text 4.1-11.1 s after clips of 3.6-10.6 s (7.2-22.4 s in utterance mode) at 4.86%/11.03% WER; a Spanish model makes 34-60% fewer errors than multilingual Whisper tiny. Code and models are released.
summaryZh: 本文介绍了Oído，一种能够在无神经加速器的低成本微控制器（ESP32-S3）上运行的开放词汇语音识别引擎。通过对13M参数的Conformer-CTC模型进行int8量化及针对性的内存调度优化，Oído在资源受限的硬件上实现了极高的识别准确率，性能优于许多在笔记本电脑上运行的轻量级模型。该研究证明了在极低功耗硬件上部署复杂语音识别任务的可行性，并开源了相关代码与模型，为边缘AI应用提供了重要参考。

glossary.explanationZh: 开放词汇，指模型不局限于预定义的关键词列表，可识别任意词汇。
微控制器，一种集成度高、资源受限的嵌入式处理器。
神经加速器，专门用于加速深度学习计算的硬件模块。
一种常用于语音识别的深度学习模型架构。
8位整数量化，一种通过降低权重精度来减小模型体积和计算量的技术。
